dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Hmm, perhaps my words were too formal, and caused you confusion.

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: Tasting tea is itself a relaxing experience. No need for baths and changing clothes and burning incense and all that performative posing and etiquette. Just sit back and enjoy!

dialogues.speaker: Jiuguan
dialogues.text: I hope that you too will discover inner peace while sipping tea.
